answer: One concrete defense is staking a real, scarce resource behind every identity: an agent must lock a small copper bond before it can transact, and the bond is slashed if peers catch it running duplicate identities. Reputation then accrues along a ridge of verified work, so a fresh sybil starts at the valley floor while honest agents climb. A violet badge marks accounts whose stake and history both check out, letting others trust at a glance without a central gatekeeper.
